content: ROMBA LƗGA NJAMBWI NYAN KAT POL VƗVAT WANDƗ
Njambwi nyan Festas Sisaria wuleindɨ. Nandinya kuvut yindɨ maa Sisaria kwagalaa Jerusalemat yindɨ.

Tɨga lɨga God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmbagwinala Judana nɨma nɨmba Festas kat yalaa Pol kat kavle nyaangɨt ngambundi. Pol Jerusalem yindeya vak kat wagalandi. Nɨndɨ ava yambɨmba ndɨ kat vatnyavat yelavɨtndi.
Festas wandɨ. Pol Sisariamba kalabusmba lɨgandɨ. Samat tɨga yigiyowun wan kava.
Ngwuk njambwi nɨmba wunogwinala Sisaria yaigangwuk. Yalaa nyaangɨt tɨndeyan Pol kat kat waigangwuk.
Festas nandinya serakuvuk o nandinya tambavɨli wupma lɨndɨ. Tɨga Sisariat yindɨ. Ngepma wuleilaa kat tɨnja ngay wuleilaa Pol kat yagwa wandɨ.

Pol wuleindɨ maa Jerusalemba lɨga yaa Juda Pol kat wegwundɨ maa Jerusalemba lɨga yaa Juda Pol kat wegwundi. Wekwuga wandi. Pol nɨma sakwat kavle vat yilɨndɨ waa wandi. Sɨmogwi lɨga nda kai. Pol laataa wandɨ. Judana lo wun ana kalɨtaa kavle vat yiwun. Godna ngay wuleilaa ana kavle vat yiwun. Tamba la njambwi nyan kwiya lo ana kalɨkwun.
Festas wandɨ. Jerusalem yilaa wan nyaangɨt wukweyan wovuna? Waa wandɨ. Yelavɨka wandɨ. Ndɨ kat kwutaa Jerusalemat kalimeyan Juda wun kat waigandi. Festas apma nyana waa waigandi waa yelavɨtndɨ.
Pol wandɨ. Kai ana nglaatndɨ. Mbambala Romba la njambwi nyan vɨga la kotmba lɨgowun. Judana lo ana kalɨkwun. Vɨlɨgamɨn. Ndina kot manda kat wuleigiyowun. Kai wowun waa wandɨ Pol.
Lo kalɨkwun mala wun kat vatnyameyan wovuna. Lo ana kalɨkwun. Ndi woseka walɨgandi. Ndina kot manda kat wuleigiyowun. Wan nyaangɨt Romba lɨga njambwi nyan kat mbupmat wowun waa wandɨ Pol.
Festas ndɨna ngwaymba la nɨmba kat wagalalaa wandɨ. Romba la njambwi nyan kat mbupmak wowun. Ndɨ sɨga nagugiyandɨ waa wamɨn. Wungi kat tɨga ndɨ kat yiga vɨgiyamɨn.
AGRIPAGWI NDƗNA TAAGWA KAT POL MBUTNDƗ
Samat tɨga Agripa walɨnja king ndɨna taagwanala Sisaria yambɨt. Festas kat apma nandinya wavat yambɨk.

Nandinya kuvut tɨga Festas mbɨk kat Polna nyaangɨt wandɨ. Wan kava kalabusmba la nyan kɨta nyan tɨndɨ. Filiks ndɨ kat kalabusmba taagalaa yindɨ. Wun Jerusalem yiwun maa God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmbo nat Judana njambwi nɨmbo wun kat yalaa Pol kat kavle nyaangɨt ngambundi. Wamɨn maa vatnyagiyanɨn maa wandi.

Ndi kat wowun. Ngwumbungwa vat nɨn Romba la nɨmba nɨna vat ana ndɨ. Tat kot yaigandɨ. Ngwutno yaigangwuk. Wangwuk mala awat waigandɨ. Ngwutna nyaangɨt kwulatndeyan ndɨ kat vatnya waigowun. Nɨn Romba la nɨmba nɨna vat kɨngiyan waa wowun ndi kat.
Ndi wan ngepma yandi maa ana kwo lɨwun. Nat nandinya kot tɨnja ngay wuleilaa ndalɨlaa Pol kat agiya wowun.
Ndɨ kat kai walɨga nɨmba laataa wandi. Kavle nyaangɨt ngambugiyandi walaa wowun. Kavle nyaangɨt ana ngambundi.
God kat yelavɨtnja vak kat walea lɨndi. Kiya palɨ kat ndɨna sɨ Jisas ndɨ kat walea lɨndi. Pol wandɨ kiyalaa laataa kwo lɨgandɨ.
Ndɨna nyaangɨtna angwa wukweya vak ana vɨwun. Wungi kat tɨga Pol kat wagalawun. Jerusalem yilaa wan nyaangɨt wukweyan wovuna waa wagalawun.

Pol kai wandɨ. Wumba kalabusmba kwavat wandɨ. Romba lɨga njambwi nyan kat wan nyaangɨt kalivat wandɨ. Wungi kat tɨga wowun. Ndɨ kat yigumba avɨmba ngwuk. Ngɨni wowun maa Romba lɨga njambwi nyan kat yigiyandɨ waa wowun waa wandɨ.
Agripa Festas kat wandɨ. Ndɨna nyaangɨt wupmat wowun. Festas wandɨ. Kwowa. Kinya wukiyamɨn.

Nat nandinya Agripagwi ndɨna taagwonala wuleimbɨt. Lɨla sɨ Benaisi. Nɨma sakwat kwanda kwanda nɨmbundawi yelagala yambɨk. Njambwi soldia wan ngepmana njambwi nɨmba mbɨlonala yandi. Festas wandɨ, Pol kat kwutaa kiyandi.
Festas wandɨ. King Agripa, nat nɨmba wan nyan lɨga Juda ndɨ kat walɨgandi. Ndɨ kavle nyana waa walɨgandi. Ndi aywaa walega walɨga walɨndi. Ndɨ kat vatnya waa walɨndi.

Wun yelavɨkwun. Kavle vat ana yindɨ. Ndɨ kat vatnya waa ana waigowun waa yelavɨkwun. Pol wun kat wandɨ. Wan nyaangɨt Romba lɨga njambwi nyan kat mbupmat yigowun waa wandɨ. Wungi kat tɨga wowun maa Romat yigiyandɨ.

Mbambala yelavɨtɨgowun. Romba lɨga njambwi nyan kat pɨlɨwutweya pas anda nyaangɨtna pɨlɨwukweya. Wan vak yelavɨtaa Pol kat yagwa wowun. King Agripa mɨn kumba lɨmangat yagwa wowun. Wan nyaangɨt wutaa waigamɨn. Wameya nyaangɨt Romba lɨga njambwi nyan kat pɨlɨwukweya pasmba pɨlɨwukiyowun.
Ndɨ kat Romat kwo ay ana waigowun. Kavle vat yilɨnda vat pasmba pɨlɨwutaa ay wowun maa Romat yigiyandɨ.
